summary: Lead pre-review of exact proposed queue architecture spec e737c2da901ae4073f7ecc066781f428020ffdd1 against ManagerHeartbeat, GitBackedTasks, DurableAgentChallenges, and orthogonal-agent-state contracts. Design direction sound; changes requested before implementation. Major gaps: (1) cross-session source continuity unspecified for dirty/uncommitted worktrees, source SHA only optional and new session may be on another machine; require durable reachable WIP snapshot or explicit workspace handoff/fencing. (2) Manager role capacity reservations not necessarily subtracted from eligible unclaimed demand, causing over-dispatch before claims on repeated/concurrent ticks; require CAS demand reservations or launch-debt subtraction. (3) Work activation yield is not necessarily launch/session terminal evidence; define one-claim-per-launch and atomic launch terminal transition/no-work, and prevent post-yield reclaims from same launch. (4) cutover explicitly drain/reconcile claimed reviews and mutating background jobs, not just Working implementation assignments and uncertain launches. (5) unknown ClaimNextWork result must resolve caller-stable operation before a fresh claim to prevent double work. Existing frozen independent design review d4fbb56e2d4c451eab1ef23c281dc647 remains unclaimed; did not modify frozen spec, record review verdict, implement, or deploy.
nextAction: Await independent reviewer of frozen architecture review d4fbb56e2d4c451eab1ef23c281dc647.
